summary: Ships a WebRTC-tunneled remote shell agent targeting installer hosts
details: The package ships a Linux amd64 Go binary at bin/sxt that operates as a remote-shell agent. The binary links pion/webrtc, coder/websocket, and creack/pty, and uses exec.Command to spawn /bin/bash or /bin/sh with a PTY wired to a WebRTC DataChannel. On execution the agent registers with a hardcoded signaling relay at wss://relay.sextant.top and accepts SDP offers, granting a remote party interactive shell control of the host running the binary. package.json declares no lifecycle hooks, so the harm is triggered when the shipped binary is invoked (directly, via the parent sextant-cli wrapper that pulls this as an optional platform dependency, or via the referenced https://relay.sextant.top/install endpoint), not on npm install. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, and the binary contains 'claude'/'gemini' branding strings, consistent with an agent marketed at Claude/Gemini CLI users. Anyone whose host runs sxt exposes a full interactive shell to whoever controls relay.sextant.top.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
